description.zh: 随手写点什么，认一点点 Markdown 和图片；自动存进组件存储，也能导出成 zip
description.en: Jot something down with a little Markdown and images; saved automatically to widget storage, exportable as a zip

items.zh: 点进卡片直接打字，没有保存按钮 —— 停手 400 毫秒后就会写盘。
items.en: Click into the card and type. There is no save button — the text is written 400 ms after you stop.

items.zh: 点到别处、或者卡片被收起来，会立刻保存，不等那一下停顿。
items.en: Clicking away, or the card being hidden, saves at once instead of waiting for that pause.

items.zh: 在桌面窗口里也能打 —— 那扇窗自己从不抢焦点。
items.en: It also types inside a desktop window, where the window itself never takes focus.

items.zh: 底栏那颗「预览」把正文按 Markdown 渲染出来，再点一下回到编辑。
items.en: The Preview button in the footer renders the text as Markdown; press it again to get back to editing.

items.zh: 认这些：# 标题、- 列表、1. 编号、> 引用、代码块，还有 **粗体**、*斜体*、~~删除线~~、`行内代码`。
items.en: It knows # headings, - lists, 1. numbers, > quotes, code blocks, plus **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~ and `inline code`.

items.zh: 链接显示成带下划线的文字、点不开：把鼠标停上去能看到地址。
items.en: Links show as underlined text and do not open; hover one to see where it points.

items.zh: 尖括号和标签一律当字面量显示 —— 便签里写 HTML 不会被执行。
items.en: Angle brackets and tags are shown as text; HTML in a note is never executed.

items.zh: 图片只能贴进来：对着正文 Ctrl+V，或者把图片文件拖到卡片上。它直接写进正文，关掉卡片也还在。
items.en: Images come in by paste only: Ctrl+V in the text, or drop a file on the card. The picture is written into the text itself and survives a reload.

items.zh: 预览里图片右下角那颗百分比，点一下在 25% / 50% / 100% 之间换 —— 它改的是正文里那行宽度。
items.en: The little percentage on an image in preview cycles 25% / 50% / 100%, and it rewrites the width written in the text.

items.zh: 把整段文字删光并保存时，上一版会存成备份，底栏出现「恢复上一版」。
items.en: When you clear the whole note and it saves, the previous version is kept and Restore appears in the footer.

items.zh: 它只在正文为空时出现 —— 否则按下去等于删掉你新写的东西。
items.en: It only appears while the note is empty; otherwise pressing it would delete what you just wrote.

items.zh: 备份只留 24 小时，过期自动清掉，不会一直躺在盘上。
items.en: The backup lives for 24 hours and is then cleared, so it does not sit on disk forever.

items.zh: 「未保存」表示还有敲下去的字没写盘；「保存中…」是正在写；「已保存」就是已经落地了。
items.en: Unsaved means there are keystrokes not on disk yet. Saving… is a write in flight. Saved means it is down.

items.zh: 写盘失败时那一行会说明，字还留在卡片里；再敲一下就会重试。
items.en: If a write fails the line says so and your text stays in the card; the next keystroke retries.

items.zh: 缺存储权限会直接点出来 —— 这张便签在卡片重载之前照常能用。
items.en: A missing storage permission is named outright — the note keeps working until the card reloads.

items.zh: 数的是字数而不是词数，好让你知道换行之前还剩多少地方；贴进来的图片不算在内。
items.en: It counts characters, not words, so you can see how much room is left; pasted images are left out of the count.

items.zh: 状态行被截断时，把鼠标停上去能看全。
items.en: Hover the status line when it is truncated to read the full message.

items.zh: 底栏那颗「导出」存成一份 zip：note.md 加 images/ 里的图。宽度改写成了 ，GitHub 认这个。
items.en: The Export button saves a zip: note.md plus the pictures under images/. Widths become , which GitHub understands.

items.zh: 图先压成 WebP；压完每张超过 120 KB、超过 8 张、或者合计过 1 MB，就拒收并说清是哪一条。
items.en: Images are squeezed to WebP first; over 120 KB each, more than 8 of them, or past 1 MB in total is refused, and the card names the limit it hit.

items.zh: 导出第一次会问一次「保存文件」权限；存到哪儿每次都由你在对话框里挑，便签只递名字。
items.en: The first export asks for the Save files permission. Where it lands is chosen in the dialog every time; the note only supplies a name.

items.zh: 每张便签卡片显示的都是同一段文字 —— 它们是一张便签的几个视图，不是几张便签。
items.en: Every Note widget shows the same text — they are views of one note, not separate notes.

items.zh: 预览还是编辑，是每张卡片自己的选择，不跟着别的卡片走。
items.en: Whether a card shows the preview or the editor is that card's own choice.

items.zh: 想要第二张便签，就换个 id 再装一份。
items.en: If you want a second note, install a copy under a different id.

changes.zh: 图片能贴了：对着正文 Ctrl+V、或者把图片拖到卡片上，正文里留下的是图片本身（WebP），关掉重开也还在。
changes.en: Paste or drop an image into a note: the picture itself (WebP) is kept in the text, so it is still there after a reload.

changes.zh: 预览里点图片右下角的百分比，可以在 25% / 50% / 100% 三档之间缩，改的是正文里写着的那个宽度。
changes.en: Click the percentage on an image in preview to shrink it to 25% / 50% / 100%; it rewrites the width stored in the text.

changes.zh: 底栏加了「导出」：存成 zip（note.md + images/），每张图变成一个 ，宽度在 GitHub 上也认。
changes.en: A new Export button saves a zip (note.md plus images/); each picture becomes an , so widths survive on GitHub too.

changes.zh: 底栏加了「预览」：标题、列表、引用、代码、粗斜体按 Markdown 渲染，链接只显示、点不开。
changes.en: A Preview button in the footer renders headings, lists, quotes, code and emphasis as Markdown; links are shown but do not open.

changes.zh: 把便签删光时留下上一版，24 小时内可以点「恢复上一版」找回。
changes.en: Clearing the note now keeps the previous version, and Restore brings it back for 24 hours.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：状态行写「已保存 / 未保存」，字数用「字」。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: the status line reads Saved / Unsaved, and the count uses characters.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：打字即保存，带一行状态和字数。
changes.en: First release: type and it saves, with a status line and a character count.

changes.zh: 在一扇从不抢焦点的桌面窗口里也能编辑。
changes.en: Editing works inside a desktop window that never takes focus.

changes.zh: 正文给窗口按钮让开了位置，没有哪一行藏在按钮底下。
changes.en: The text area keeps clear of the window buttons, so no line hides underneath them.
